title: praxis.group-verification/1
description: The per-member, per-criterion verification pass of a grouped execution (PRX-GRP-045, PRX-GRP-134), supplied as `work complete --evidence group-verification=PATH`. One row per acceptance criterion the group analysis enumerates for the member; a row that is not `met` names, in `deferredTo`, a recorded non-terminal work item that takes the criterion over. Evidence is an attestation checked for presence and consistency, not proof.

reference.description: A test name, a command, or path[:line] that must exist at the completion commit.
